newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: RUGBY UNION-TRANSVAAL TO MEET NATAL IN FINAL.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-TRANSVAAL TO MEET NATAL IN FINAL.

text.p: Transvaal reached the Currie Cup final where they will play Natal at Ellis Park next Saturday by beating Northern Transvaal 31-21 at Loftus Versfeld.
Northern Transvaal - Tries: Jacques Olivier, Penalty Try. Conversion: Lance Sherrell. Penalties: Lance Sherrell (3).
Transvaal - Tries: Gavin Lawless, Japie Mulder, Rudolf Straeuli. Conversions: Gavin Lawless (2). Penalties: Gavin Lawless (3). Drop Goal: Hennie le Roux.
